dct_title_s: Sheriff Reporting Districts, San Joaquin County, California, 2015
dct_description_sm: This point shapefile contains the reporting districts of the San Joaquin County California Sherrif's department as of 2015. This layer is part of a collection of GIS data for San Joaquin County in California.

This dataset is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
